name: tag-leaking
why: Schema-valid, but a page's text carries a `<thinking>` fragment. `output_config.format` constrains structure, never string content.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Requires an internal tag to leak into a schema-valid string. `output_config.format` constrains structure, never string content, so the branch must exist; the leak cannot be requested.
